gettingStarted: First create an account and set a PIN — you only need to do this once. Choose a simple PIN you'll remember, e.g. your wife's birth year

Set up a handset or the phone app for driving. One handset can hold several locomotives, and you can always reprogram it for different ones

drive.heading: Set up driving
drive.pickDeviceHint: Tap the large card that matches your device.
whatToChooseBody: If you have a LongFred or WiFred handset, choose it. If you have a WlanMaus instead and know how to use it, I can help you set that up too.
Don't have a physical handset? Choose the BigFred app on an Android phone or on another phone.
The other options are for advanced users and require technical knowledge. Unfortunately, as much as I'd like to, I won't be able to help here if you have an unknown device or an unfamiliar app.

account.heading: New participant account
account.loginHint: Only letters a–z / A–Z, no spaces or accented characters, e.g. tom
account.whyAccount: Why do I need an account?
account.whyAccountBody: So you can program a handset, so no one else can take your vehicles, and so we can automate how the layout runs by knowing which vehicle is passing through, and so we as organizers can see who uses the layout and how, for organizational purposes. In return you get the app, easy pairing of wireless handsets, and control from your phone. I think it’s worth it! Have fun!
account.organizationHint: Saved as the organization in BigFred
account.pinAdvice: A simple numeric password you will remember — e.g. your spouse’s or child’s year of birth. You will need it to program a handset or use the phone app.
account.rememberCredentials: Remember your login and PIN — you will need them to sign in on the phone app.
account.pinTooShort: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
account.loginTooShort: The login needs at least 3 characters.
account.loginInvalidChars: The login may contain only letters a–z and A–Z (no accented characters, digits, or symbols).
account.summaryLead: The account gets a pool of {{count}} DCC addresses.

loco.heading: Locomotive setup
loco.noDccPool: Sorry — you have no DCC address pool. Please ask the layout administrator.
loco.whyPickUser: Why do I need to choose?
whyPickUserBody: Your locomotive is assigned to you. No one else can drive it — that's how we designed it! Unless you consciously lend it to someone <smile/>
That also lets us plan future layout features — announcements, screens for the audience, and other interesting technical solutions — knowing who is driving where. Isn't that fascinating progress?
loco.whereDccNumber: Where do I get the number?
whereDccNumberBody: You don't need to know the DCC number — I'll pick one from your BigFred account pool and then program the decoder.
I've already filled it in; you can change it, but it's better to leave it as is — it's good!
No worries! Because BigFred remembers your locomotive, you don't need to remember its DCC address — I remember the address, and you remember the locomotive's name! <smile/>
loco.pickLoco: Which locomotive are we setting up?
loco.pickLocoHint: Pick from the list, or add a new one if it is missing.
loco.addNewLoco: I did not find my locomotive on this list — I need to add it
loco.addressExplain: Everyone has a list of DCC addresses they can assign to their vehicles — here are yours. Your new vehicle will get DCC number {{address}}
loco.functionListDescribe: You can optionally copy a function list onto your vehicle from another vehicle, so the BigFred phone app or a LongFred handset shows function names and icons. This step is optional — your model may not be on the list; if so, choose “Basic”.
loco.outsidePool: The address must be inside your DCC pool.
loco.putOnTrackProgram: Put the locomotive/vehicle on the programming track and tap Program.
loco.programSuccess: Address {{address}} written to the decoder. Vehicle “{{name}}” is ready.
loco.testF2Hint: F2 runs on the powered main track (ops). Move the loco off the programming track onto powered rails, then tap the button — F2 stays on for 1 second.
